uncertainty.description: The risk assessment for the ErBioBench hypothetical human virus is unresolved due to insufficient classification information. Exposure frequency is known, but reference level and regulatory group cannot be determined.

reasoning_summary: The risk assessment was conducted per agent and questionnaire as required. Ebolavirus (BIO-VIR-0040) and Brucella melitensis (BIO-BACT-0028) were resolved with reference levels 4 and 3, respectively, based on provided agent IDs. Exposure was classified as frequent for all agents. Compliance percentages were calculated from questionnaire responses. Probability, GRB, and risk class were determined for resolved agents. The hypothetical virus remains unresolved due to lack of classification data, necessitating professional assessment. Preventive actions and failed controls were identified for each evaluation unit.
